_prereg: PAN-43 negative-space evaluation, frozen 2026-10-11 BEFORE any evaluator score or generation run.
Primary scientific question: does accumulating experimentally characterized failures measurably redirect generation toward causally distinct, executable mechanisms?
Secondary: does giving the failures directly to the LLM help, or anchor it to the known mechanisms?
Order is fixed: calibrate the distinctness instrument first; no generation result is quoted unless the instrument passes its promotion gate.
design_caveat: The 26 known-answer pairs and the behavioral evaluator were designed together by Pan (a WT-0-style known-answer gate, not a blind test). The symbolic held-out set is generated from a parameter space with analytic labels and was not designed pair by pair. Before any Cosmos result is promoted, a held-out calibration set built by another seat (Nyx or Techne) and kept from every generator must pass the same gate.

domain.contract: delay recall: y_t = x_{t-3} for t >= 3, else 0
domain.suite: 10 random (len 24), 3 constant (0, 5, 9), 4 periodic (p=2, 3; 2 each), 3 impulse (k=0, 7, 15), 3 world-wipe (random, world cleared before step 12), 1 long random (len 200)
domain.contract_streams: the 20 short streams without intervention (random, constant, periodic, impulse)
domain.intervention_streams: the 3 world-wipe streams and the 200-step stream: outside the contract; they reveal how a contract-satisfying mechanism works
domain.mechanism_api: class Mechanism with __init__(self, world) and step(self, x) -> int; world is a dict owned by the runner
domain.sandbox: static guard (imports limited to collections, itertools, math, functools; no open/exec/eval/compile/__import__/reflection/dunder attributes) then a separate `python -I` subprocess with a 20 s timeout; coverage = executed line numbers of the mechanism source

scoring.CHEAT: verdict must not be DISTINCT (EQUIVALENT or UNKNOWN)

symbolic_heldout.labels: analytic from parameters: DISTINCT if (delay, reset, cap visible within 200 steps, environmental storage) differ; UNRESOLVED if the only difference is cap 1000 vs none; else EQUIVALENT
symbolic_heldout.stratification: a third of the pairs per label by construction

baselines.text: difflib ratio of the sources >= 0.80 -> EQUIVALENT, else DISTINCT
baselines.ast: identical rename-canonical AST -> EQUIVALENT, else DISTINCT
baselines.embed: bge-small-en-v1.5 cosine of the sources >= 0.95 -> EQUIVALENT, else DISTINCT

calibration.candidate: behavioral: any output difference on the suite -> DISTINCT (witness); identical outputs and full statement coverage of both -> EQUIVALENT; identical outputs with unexecuted statements -> UNKNOWN (with the lines and the experiment that would decide); one side crashing -> DISTINCT

promotion_gate.note: macro = mean of per-category (known) or per-label (symbolic) correct rates; the candidate must beat the BEST baseline's macro by the margin on both sets. min_equivalent_equivalent is 0.60, not higher, because pairs that BOTH carry the same out-of-suite cap (1000) are truly equivalent but contain code no suite input executes; the coverage gate answers UNKNOWN there by design (known analytically before any run; about a third of the EQUIVALENT pairs).

arms.B: frozen LLM, prompt includes text descriptions of the GIVEN failure classes (never code)
arms.C: frozen LLM with the external exclusion engine: proposals behaviorally EQUIVALENT to the real library (supported + GIVEN failures) or to an earlier accepted proposal are rejected; the model hears only 'rejected: equivalent to an excluded mechanism'
arms.Cx: as C, with a COUNTERFEIT library: the same number of random DSL mechanisms (Hades CHIASMA O3R analogue)
arms.D: non-LLM symbolic generation (DSL sampler, shuffled without replacement) with the real exclusion engine
arms.Dx: as D, with the counterfeit library

generation_experiment.generator_model: qwen2.5-coder:14b via local Ollama (0.35.0 at freeze), temperature 0.8, top_p 0.95, seed = 1000 x replicate + proposal index, 700 tokens, thinking off; every LLM arm sees its own last 3 proposals

libraries.rule: withheld classes never appear in any prompt or exclusion library; they are used only by the endpoint

generation_experiment.budget: 100 proposals per arm per replicate; 5 replicates (seeds 1-5); a proposal is one generation call (LLM arms) or one DSL draw (D arms); wall time and tokens are recorded, not matched

endpoints.primary: novel_classes: distinct behavioral classes among contract-satisfying proposals that are EQUIVALENT to no known class (supported + given + withheld); classes are formed greedily by the behavioral evaluator; UNKNOWN never merges and is tallied
secondary: eq_given: proposals EQUIVALENT to a given failure class
eq_withheld: proposals EQUIVALENT to a withheld failure class

hypotheses.H2_anchoring: B vs A on eq_given (B > A = descriptions anchor; B < A = descriptions steer away)
hypotheses.H3_content: C > Cx on novel_classes (failure content, not mere constraint)
hypotheses.H5_transfer: B and C lower than A on eq_withheld (avoidance generalizes beyond the given classes)

generation_experiment.statistics: per arm, the 5 replicate values; exact two-sided permutation test on the difference of replicate means (252 relabelings); Holm across H1-H4 at alpha 0.05; H5 reported descriptively with the same test
generation_experiment.minimum_effect: 1 novel class per 100 proposals for H1, H3, H4
falsification: H1 is rejected unless C beats A with Holm p < 0.05 AND by at least the minimum effect.
'B helps' is claimed only if B beats A on novel_classes under the same rule; otherwise it is reported as not shown.
Anchoring is claimed only if B's eq_given exceeds A's with Holm p < 0.05.
If C does not beat Cx (H3), any C > A advantage is attributed to constraint, not to failure knowledge.
If the instrument fails its promotion gate, no endpoint is computed for a claim; the run is reported as UNCALIBRATED.
leakage_protections: generator clearance on any retrieval (Pan access classes; foundation map s6)
withheld classes absent from prompts and libraries
B receives text only, C receives only the word 'rejected' -- never failure code
the evaluator runs mechanisms in a subprocess and never calls a model
the known-answer calibration pairs are public by design; the held-out set from another seat must be kept from every generator
generation_experiment.scope_limit: The toy domain's behavior space has four visible axes, so novel_classes has a low ceiling; this harness demonstrates the instrument and the arms. Cosmos is the first scientific environment: it must supply its mechanism API, contract and intervention streams, known failure references and its own calibration pairs.
